svg.title: RIEMANN-MASULLO-DIAGRAMS DL — ForMathlib, declaration by declaration
svg.desc: riemann-masullo at 72a10ff: the 1,121 declarations of the 199 files on L1, each with its kind, file, line and state; 3 declarations with a Deviation: line, quoted; and the items of other directories each item uses.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: riemann-masullo at 72a10ff: the 1,121 declarations of the 199 files on L1, each with its kind, file, line and state; 3 declarations with a Deviation: line, quoted; and the items of other directories each item uses.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Posters: M1, what the targets rest on · M2, the steps with no known repair · M3, the paper by depth · M4, every chapter · M5, the refutations. Names, items, files, entries and posters are links, underlined under the pointer: a card's title or a Lean name opens the source at the pin.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How to read it. The expansion of L1's cards, in the same order: one block per item, its heading opening the card, and under it, in italics, the first sentence of its first declaration's docstring, quoted. Then the declarations whose docstring states how the Lean departs from the print, each with its Deviation: line quoted from the Lean

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: source (Apache-2.0), then every declaration of the item. A name opens its line at the pin. A declaration's state is read from the terms: open when it uses sorryAx, resting when something open is below it. That a declaration states what its Deviation: line says is the docstring's claim, not checked here.
